Interface BrokerListener<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of data produced by the channel
All Superinterfaces:
Comparable<BrokerListener<T>>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractMessenger
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface BrokerListener<T> extends Comparable<BrokerListener<T>>
Represents and operation that accept a channel name and the data produced by a Broker.

Unlike Consumer, this operation can throw an IOException.
